description: Transfers the policy circuits' list rules admit or refuse. Each case carries table rows and mint thresholds installed into asset records, the eight source slots, the records of the ring's own and of the curator registry by member, the sender member and every UTXO output's owner, asset and amount. A subject reads list i + 1 from the curator record when source slot i names a registry field, else from its own record, an absent member reads zero. A rule holds when the subject is on any list of its present set or off any list of its absent set. A zero owner carries no owner obligation. An owner's guard per asset is its same-ring outputs less its ring_inputs, floored at zero, plus its outputs with ring false. A scalar guard exempts that guard, or on an asset rule its sum over the asset's owners, at or below the threshold. An asset guard reads the mint's record threshold, zero without one. The outcome is pass, or the first refusal in table order then output order. Produced by program-libs/policy/tests/policy_rules_vector.rs.
